snippet.title: Dungeon Blitz: R — Demo Gameplay
snippet.description:
Dungeon Blitz: R is here!
The project is still unfinished, but development is actively continuing.
Right now we are fixing small issues and making improvements in the private repository.

The multiplayer version is planned, and once it is ready, it will be released publicly.
We will make an official announcement as soon as the multiplayer build is available.

Thank you for your patience and support.
